brief: @buildthis.bisks.net something that listens to the firehose for posts that could have conceivably originated 10 years ago, i.e. posts that make no reference to contemporary events/culture/persons from after the current date in 2016
note: watches the live firehose for posts that trip none of ~150 post-2016 markers (no covid, no ChatGPT, no explicit later year) — a live, imperfect museum of "nothing here rules it out."
